description: Run and manage Tenable vulnerability scans, find assets and vulnerabilities, export findings and scan reports, tag assets, and start workflows when scans finish or fail, new critical vulnerabilities or assets appear, or vulnerabilities are fixed.

tenable_new_asset_trigger.description: Runs for each asset Tenable sees for the first time, with its names, addresses and operating system. Checks at most every 15 minutes.

output.first_seen: When a scan or agent first saw it (ISO 8601).
output.has_agent: Whether a Tenable agent runs on it.
output.last_scan_target: The address it was last scanned at.

tenable_new_audit_log_event_trigger.description: Runs for each new audit log event, such as a sign-in, a new user or a changed setting, with who did it and whether it failed. Needs an administrator's API keys. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.actor_id: The id of who did it.
output.fields: More details, as key and value pairs.
output.target_id: The id of what it was done to.
output.target_type: What kind of thing that is, such as User.

parameters.description: Only events of this action, such as user.create or user.authenticate.password. Leave blank for every event.
parameters.name: event_action

tenable_new_vulnerability_trigger.description: Runs for each vulnerability newly found on an asset, critical and high unless other severities are chosen, with the asset, the plugin and how to fix it. Checks at most every 15 minutes.

output.last_fixed: When it was fixed (ISO 8601), if it was.
output.plugin_id: The plugin (check) that found it, for 'Get plugin'.
output.port: The port it was found on.
output.severity: critical, high, medium, low or info.

parameters.description: Which severities to watch: critical, high, medium, low or info, separated by commas. Leave blank for critical and high.
parameters.name: severities

tenable_scan_completed_trigger.description: Runs when a scan run finishes, with the scan's id, name and times. Runs that finished before the workflow was turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.name: The scan's name.
output.scan_id: The scan's id, for 'Get scan results' or 'Export scan results'.
output.total_targets: How many targets the scan covers.

parameters.description: Only this scan. Leave blank for every scan.
parameters.name: scan_id

tenable_scan_failed_trigger.description: Runs when Tenable aborts a scan run because it ran into problems (a scan someone stopped doesn't count). How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.name: The scan's name.
output.scan_id: The scan's id, for 'Get scan results' or 'Export scan results'.
output.total_targets: How many targets the scan covers.

parameters.description: Only this scan. Leave blank for every scan.
parameters.name: scan_id

tenable_vulnerability_fixed_trigger.description: Runs for each vulnerability Tenable no longer finds on an asset, with the asset and the plugin. Checks at most every 15 minutes.

output.last_fixed: When it was fixed (ISO 8601), if it was.
output.plugin_id: The plugin (check) that found it, for 'Get plugin'.
output.port: The port it was found on.
output.severity: critical, high, medium, low or info.

parameters.description: Which severities to watch: critical, high, medium, low or info, separated by commas. Leave blank for every severity.
parameters.name: severities
